offering_description.value: Processes and sells canned, frozen and jarred produce to grocery retailers, foodservice distributors, other food companies and government food programs. It sources crops from growers and uses its U.S. plants to make branded and private-label foods and pack products under contract.

primary_products.value: canned vegetables; frozen vegetables; jarred specialty produce; fruit snack chips; metal food cans

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery and mass-market retailers, foodservice distributors, and food manufacturers and marketers; B2G: U.S. government agencies that procure food for assistance programs

end_markets.value: grocery retail; institutional and commercial foodservice; food manufacturing; public food assistance

revenue_model.value: product sales: Branded and private-label packaged produce, snack foods and metal cans; project or contract: Processing and packing vegetables for other food companies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns growers’ crops into packaged foods for retailers, distributors, food companies and government buyers; service provider: Processes and packs produce to order for other food companies; component supplier: Makes metal food cans for other food packers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; component supplier

geography_served.value: global: U.S. processing and nationwide sales, with exports to customers in multiple countries

specialization.value: related lines: Canned and frozen vegetables, jarred produce, fruit snacks, contract packing and food cans

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Retail chains, food manufacturers, contract-packing customers and government procurement programs; distributors / dealers: Foodservice distributors serving commercial and institutional kitchens; third-party retail: Supermarkets, mass merchants, club stores and discount retailers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety, labeling and low-acid canned food rules apply to processing and packaging.

notes: The current scope of third-party can sales is uncertain.
